description:
Front Garden:
T1:  Olive:  Approximately 5.00m.  Reduce crown by approximately 30%, up to approximately 1.50m.  Thin crown density by approximately 20%.

Rear Garden:
T2:  Mature Apple:  Approximately 7.00m.  Reduce back to previous and most recent points of reduction, approximately 1.20m.  Thin crown density evenly throughout by 20-25%.  Remove major dead wood.
T3:  Pittosporum:  Approximately 5.00m.  Reduce crown by approximately 1.20m as is practicable.  Thin density by 15-20% to control encroachment and increase light levels to the lawn.
T4:  Mature Yew - (rose covered):  Approximately 4.50-5.00m.  Reduce whole crown (including Rose) by up to approximately 1.25m as is practicable.
T5:  Robinia - (overhanging from No.26 St Georges Avenue):  Prune back lateral and sub lateral branches growing across the boundary and over No.24 by approximately 1.50m.  Thin crown density over No.24 only, by 20%.  Remove dead wood overhanging No.24.
Reason/s:  General maintenance to control encroachment and increase light levels.
